areas.name: Women
areas.reason: Gender-inclusion actions in several products and a dedicated indicator, but a very small resource share makes it an inclusive measure rather than a policy reinforcement.

areas.name: Anti-racism
areas.reason: Racial-equity actions in several products and a dedicated indicator, but small resources; inclusive measure rather than structural, cross-cutting action.

areas.name: Decarbonization
areas.reason: Technology-modernization and biotechnology park products relate directly; indicators and targets viable, but about a tenth of resources, so moderate impact.

areas.name: Competitiveness
areas.reason: Directly tied to the general objective, a main component, many products and most indicators; resource share is moderate, solutions efficient and innovative.

areas.name: Science, technology and innovation
areas.reason: Innovation ecosystem, AI centre and human-capital products with viable targets, but a small resource share gives low impact.

areas.name: Logistics and transport
areas.reason: Logistics efficiency component and road indicators, but the project is restricted to road transport, not the modes named in the area; limited impact.

areas.name: Trade
areas.reason: Addresses export concentration and low value added with relevant products and indicators, but a very small resource share gives low impact.

areas.name: Family farming
areas.reason: Relation to family farming only inferred; no components, products or indicators specifically targeting the area, so impact could not be assessed.

areas.name: Labor
areas.reason: Jobs for the poorest are only a subsidiary consequence; no specific objectives, components, products, indicators or targets.

areas.name: Digital inclusion and connectivity
areas.reason: General objective not related to digital transformation or connectivity; a few digital products and indicators exist but with low resource share the area was not scored.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: Area is read as inequality between Brazilian regions; road works within a single state do not meet the minimum.

areas.name: State capacity
